purpose: Freeze benchmark point-in-time lineage before factor outcomes are inspected.

ownership.rule: D19-15 constructs/version-controls benchmarks; D19-01 interprets benchmark-relative alpha/residuals; D19-10 performs exposure/redundancy/spanning diagnostics.

failClosedRules: Current constituents or weights MUST NOT be backfilled into historical dates.
announcementAt MUST NOT be treated as effectiveFrom.
Price-index and total-return-index semantics MUST NOT be mixed.
Benchmark choice and returnType are frozen before factor outcomes; multiple benchmarks form one multiple-testing family.
Imported non-Taiwan factor returns are contextual evidence only until Taiwan-equivalence is separately demonstrated.

officialEvidence.evidence: Quarterly review uses data at close on Monday four weeks before effective date; changes are announced after first Friday close and implemented after third Friday close, effective Monday.
